name: No dual-control on outgoing payments above a threshold
description: Any single person can initiate and approve a payment of arbitrary size.

name: Payment instructions accepted by email alone
description: Suppliers can change bank details via email with no out-of-band verification.

name: No multi-factor authentication on critical accounts
description: Email, banking, and admin accounts log in with password only.

name: Sensitive data stored without encryption at rest
description: Customer or employee personal data sits on disks, USB drives, or backups in plaintext.

name: No documented leavers process
description: When someone leaves, their access isn't revoked promptly across all systems.

name: Single-supplier dependency for a critical input
description: A core part of the business runs through one supplier with no fallback.

name: No exit plan for critical suppliers
description: If a critical supplier disappears, the business has no documented switch-over plan.

name: No compliance / filing calendar
description: Filing deadlines, licence renewals, and supervisory deliverables are tracked in someone's head.

name: No named owner for compliance
description: It's unclear which person is responsible for compliance with sector or tax rules.

name: Backups exist but are never tested
description: Backup files exist but no one has restored from them in the last 12 months.

name: No regular patching cadence for software and firmware
description: Operating systems, browsers, and key software run versions months or years out of date.

name: Critical processes are undocumented
description: Only one person knows how a critical task is done.

name: No succession plan for the owner / key directors
description: If the owner or a key director is unavailable, no one is empowered to act for the business.

name: No background vetting for hires in trust positions
description: Bookkeepers, finance staff, and others with access to money or data are hired without basic checks.

name: No complaint or incident log
description: Customer complaints and operational incidents are handled ad-hoc; no record of patterns.

name: No protocol for press / social-media incidents
description: If something goes public, no one knows who speaks for the business or in what tone.

name: No fire-test or evacuation drill
description: Fire equipment, alarms, and evacuation routes are not tested on a known cadence.

name: No physical-incident log
description: Workplace injuries, near-misses, and equipment failures are not recorded.

name: High customer concentration
description: A single customer or small handful represents > 30% of revenue.

name: No cash buffer for a 60-90 day shock
description: If income paused for 60-90 days, the business could not meet payroll or rent.
